caption: A glossy dark-brown sheet lies on a white paper-like surface, its scalloped, wavy edge running diagonally across the frame. Bright rainbow iridescent reflections trace the undulating edge, while small bubble-like dots scatter across the brown surface and a few thin curved shavings rest on the white area below. The viewpoint drifts slowly, shifting the wavy edge, the shavings, and the dot marks across the frame in a changing perspective. As the angle shifts, the colored reflection bands slide and reshape along the edge, their hues brightening and dimming while the scalloped outline itself remains unchanged. A separate brown lump enters view at the far left border, becoming a persistent partial object there. The drift continues across the sheet, leaving the iridescent edge and surface marks in steady motion.
